title: WendTextArea
description: A labeled multi-line text input with optional help text.

label.description: The textarea's label text. Can be an empty string for a label-less textarea.

placeholder.description: Placeholder text shown when the textarea is empty.

help-text.description: Supplementary message shown below the textarea, e.g. a validation message. Can be an empty string to render nothing.

show-help-text.description: Whether the help text is rendered.

state.description: Validation state of the textarea. Drives the field's border color and the help text's tone. The interactive focus ring is handled separately via CSS `:focus-within`, not this prop.

required.description: Marks the textarea as required. Renders a marker after the label and sets the native `required`/`aria-required` attributes on the textarea.

name.description: Name submitted for this textarea when part of a form.
